soft_deny: Bash(npx eas-cli submit:*) in this repo — prevent accidental TestFlight/App Store submission outside the documented three-step build→check→submit sequence (CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids --auto-submit)
environment: **Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Default / protected branches**: main is the default branch; no classic protected branches listed and rulesets were not queryable here — do not treat main as unprotected on that basis alone
**CI/CD deploy targets**: EAS Build/Submit (eas.json) for iOS TestFlight/App Store; Vercel static export for the web/ marketing site; keys come from EAS environment variables, never the repo
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine (macOS) with open internet
**Source control**: The trusted repo (github.com:williampsmith/grounded.git) and its remote only — no additional orgs configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: local-first app data stays on-device (SQLite); `.env.local` and `*.key` / `.env*.local` files per .gitignore patterns; any file or store holding personal, confidential, credential, or regulated data, shared only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (iOS app, LivingTree — local-first sobriety companion built on Expo SDK 57)
routine under src/dev/ and src/app/dev/ (dev-only tooling excluded from release bundles) within this repo
